recommendation: First narrow candidate: Claude warm stream-json native final, reusing the existing shared warm adapter settlement and WorkerFinalOutput transaction slot. Ordinary Codex exec remains an explicit separate follow-up; never substitute app-server or host mode for its baseline.
why: Shared warm adapter already holds original Run credential through native drain and final-output submission, then releases it before returning RunExit.
Claude warm driver already attributes result to accepted input UUID, tracks tools and drains native work; it currently does not emit a finalOutputCandidate.

Generic cold close currently revokes activation environment before activity finish; implementing cold submission there would require careful changes to both direct and supervised exit ordering, not a one-line stdout hook.

currentEvidence.finding: Explicit final-output is currently restricted to Codex and OpenCode warm drivers; Claude is excluded.

Issue original Worker credential; drain collector/integrity writes; submit only clean completed outcome without inflight tools, supervision or cancellation; close submission then release/revoke original turn handle.
Tool set and result-to-input UUID attribution exist; turn.drained carries Run/native wake IDs/status/tool count but no finalOutputCandidate.
Both direct and supervised child close call releaseEnvironment before activity.finish; no WorkerFinalOutput currently wired.
generic, Claude stream-json and Codex app-server are distinct adapters. Claude cold wraps GenericProcessAdapter with a per-Run Worker lease; app-server Codex is not an exec baseline.
Existing Codex final collector requires app-server threadId/turnId/item final_answer/turn completed; cannot reuse its event contract as proof for ordinary exec JSON.
Host records actual execution outcome; nonpublished final-output with no durable marker goes action_required, completion remains Kernel ACK-gated.
Existing dedicated final-output HTTP endpoint, one cached submission promise, no retry, held/rejected/unknown receipts. No new protocol owner needed.

minimumOwnerChanges.change: Collect one bounded final assistant text from original accepted native input/session/Run; require matching normal successful result and end_turn evidence, unique message identity, no unresolved tools or unattributed/intermediate/error output. Emit candidate via existing finalOutputCandidate field only after clean drain. Multiple busy inputs/finals initially reject as ambiguous; do not guess which prose is business intent.

Explicitly opt in only supported Claude native-final mode. Bind body to Host frozen delivery seq, serialize existing envelope internally for WorkerFinalOutput; model emits ordinary text. Retain old provider envelope guidance where still in use. Do not blindly add Claude to existing flag since that flag currently requests JSON.

Verify candidate mode only selected for the tested warm path and included in runtime reuse identity; preserve same native session, memory settings and access grants. Cold/fallback must remain explicitly old supported mode or reject candidate admission; never silently claim native-final coverage.

Prefer no behavior change: assert existing durable-marker lookup and action_required handling for held/unknown/rejected/invalid; if proof lacks candidate under opted-in mode it must yield explicit invalid/rejected receipt, not silently undefined and generic auto-retry.

requiredOrdering: Before delivery: freeze explicit mode, original Run credential, native session/turn or accepted input UUID, delivered sequence.
Native final evidence and all tools complete; drain activity/usage/integrity writes. Runtime normal close/drain alone is not business completion.
While original execution authority remains valid, submit once through WorkerFinalOutput. Never release/rebind token first.
Persist receipt/disposition, then revoke/close handle. Record actual Run termination independently, including rejection and unknown.
Only successful committed final marker plus delivery ACK permit Activation completion. Unknown verifies durable marker; absent/unavailable proof holds action_required, no resend or fresh model retry.

codexExecFollowup.scope: Ordinary installed codex exec --json, initial/resume same native session; no explicit app-server command or silent host-mode conversion.
codexExecFollowup.needed: Dedicated exec evidence binding to launch, thread/session and current turn lifecycle; partial agent_message or process exit is insufficient. Audit actual exec event availability first, then reuse same WorkerFinalOutput owner. The app-server collector is not evidence compatibility.
codexExecFollowup.orderingRisk: Both direct and supervised close paths release credentials too early for a post-final publication hook. Avoid globally reordering all providers without scoped tests, preserve spawn-error/cancel/crash cleanup and actual Run exit provenance.

negativeAcceptance: Mode off / unrelated stdout never publishes.
Wrong session/input UUID/Run, historical replay, conflicting finals, intermediate/length/error final, pending tools and busy ambiguity never publish.
Candidate missing in enabled mode cannot silently become auto-retry or completion.
Worker credential remains valid until submission settles; revoke after success, held, invalid, unknown and cancellation; no replacement token.
Stale remains held; lost response does not duplicate canonical post or start a new model turn.
Durable committed marker plus ACK may recover unknown success; unavailable marker lookup remains action_required.
Run termination preserves actual runtime outcome even if publication fails; no rewriting exited Run.
Native same-session continuation, usage/context/memory policy unchanged.
notDone: No production code changes, tests, CLI launches or service restart in this planning task.
